page.title: Profile
page.description: Manage your name, email, and account.

form.generalDescription: Update your name. Your email is managed by your login provider.
form.emailNote: Your email address can't be changed here.

dangerZone.title: Danger zone
dangerZone.description: Deleting your account signs you out everywhere and schedules it for permanent removal. Workspaces only you belong to are deleted with it. You can restore your account by signing in before it is removed.
dangerZone.dialogDescription: This will schedule your account for deletion and sign you out of every session. Sign in again before it is removed to restore it. Type <token>{token}</token> to confirm.
dangerZone.deleted: Your account has been scheduled for deletion

errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.providerError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.reauthenticationRequired: For your security, sign out and sign in again, then delete your account.
errors.soleOwner: You're the only owner of {count, plural, one {the workspace} other {the workspaces}} {workspaces}, which other people belong to. Make another member an owner, or delete the workspace, before deleting your account.

email.subject: Your account has been scheduled for deletion
email.heading: Account deletion scheduled
email.body: Your account ({email}) has been scheduled for deletion and will be removed permanently on {date, date, long}.
email.restore: Changed your mind? Sign in before then and confirm to restore it.
email.warning: If this wasn't you, sign in and restore your account, then change your password.
